card.name: Linking words in cardiovascular warnings
card.fires_on: Small linking words (to, by, commas, a) inside warning sentences about blood pressure, heart response, or hyperkalemia risk. They come right before the thing affected or the next risk factor.

modes.label: to/by after response or impairment
modes.description: The word 'to' or 'by' after 'respond', 'responsiveness' or 'compromised', before the stimulus or cause.
modes.example: Thiazides have been shown to decrease arterial responsiveness<< to>> norepinephrine (an effect

modes.label: comma in risk-factor list
modes.description: A comma between listed risk factors for hyperkalemia.
modes.example: Risk factors for the development of hyperkalemia include renal insufficiency<<,>> diabetes mellitus, and the concom
